The Sub-Inspector of Police, Jayanagara Police Station, Bengaluru City has filed Police Report against the all accused for the offences punishable under Sections 120B and 420 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The complainant being the Chief Manager of Syndicate Bank has lodged this information on the ground that accused No.1 has availed personal loan for Rs.23,00,000/- for the purchased of the site and for construction of his building.
Accused No.2 (who was dropped ) is a surety to the said loan.
This accused No.1 has also created an unregistered Equitable mortgage deed in favour of the Bank by depositing the Title Deeds with the Bank on 15.09.2006.
The Bank has released an amount of Rs.12,95,000/- on 14.09.2006 from the housing loan account through DD in favour of the seller.
Both borrower and the surety have made agreement to repay the loan amount in installment to Syndicate Bank.
Later, accused No.1 failed to repay the loan amount.
Legal Notice was issued on 30.11.2007 to the accused No.1 but this accused No.1 has not paid the loan amount and even he has not paid the loan amount after the account became NPA.
Accordingly, on 26.11.2006 the Bank has issued Possession Notice.
The said notice was served on accused No.1, but he has not responded to the notice.
The Bank had suspected the existence of the said property pledged had assigned the valuer by name Mr. T.S.Chandrashekar.
He has filed his Valuation Report on 31.10.2009 and stated that the property was not at all inexistence.
The Bank has also taken the legal opinion from Advocates Mr.B.M.Baliga.
In the said legal opinion, it was contended that though the Bank holds genuine sale deed in their custody, but the said property does not physically exist.
An endorsement from BBMP dated 31.10.2009 also suggests the same.
The non-existence of the property covered by the sale deed and mortgage, it is clear fraud on the Bank.

The borrower accused No.1 and the surety executor Mr.K.Gangadhar Kamath and the vendor Sri. Ramaiah in collusion have entered into a criminal conspiracy to cheat the Syndicate Bank to the tune of Rs.12,95,000/-.
They were aware that the said property does not exist and played fraud to the Bank by availing loan of Rs.12,95,000/-.
The informant had been to the Police Station and lodged the information against all accused.
3. Based on the First Information of CW1, the case was registered in Crime No.56/2010 at Jayanagara Police Station, Bengaluru City.
During investigation, accused No.1 was secured and appeared before this Court and enlarged on bail.
The copies of the Police Report and other Prosecution papers are furnished to accused No.1 under Section 207 of Cr.P.C. Accused No.2 is left out from the charge-sheet.
The presence of accused No.3 could not be secured and hence the case against him was split up on 20.04.2017.

On completion of the investigation, the Sub-Inspector of Police, Jayanagara Police Station, Bengaluru City has filed Police Report against accused No.1 alleging that he has committed the offences punishable under Sections 120B and 420 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

After hearing, since there were grounds for presuming that accused No.1 has committed offences triable by this court, the charges for the offences punishable under Sections 120B and 420 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code has been framed and read over to him in Kannada language.
He has pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.

7. My answers to the above points are as follows:
 Point No.1 : In the Negative,
 Point No.2 : As per final order for the following;
 REASONS 8. POINT No.1 :- It is the case of the Prosecution that accused No.1, 2 and 3 in collusion with each other have played fraud to the Bank by obtaining loan of Rs.12,95,000/- on the non-existence of property.
Based on the information detailed investigation was conducted and the Police Sub- Inspector has filed Final Report.
9. To prove the guilt of accused No.1, the Prosecution has examined CW1/PW1 K.Diwakar, who is the Retired DGM of Syndicate Bank.
He has deposed in his evidence that on 15.09.2006 accused No.1 had taken loan of Rs.22,00,000/- from their Bank to purchase site and for the construction.
Accused No.2 stood as surety and accused No.3 was the owner of the property.
On 12.09.2016 they have sanctioned an amount of Rs.12,90,000/- in the name of the owner of the property accused No.3.
Accused No.1 was irregular in the payment of the installments.
Thereafter, they have issued intimation to the Legal Cell of their Bank to value the property, wherein they have opined that the sale deed was duly registered but the site is not in existence.
They have issued Notice to accused No.1 on 26.11.2016, but he has not repaid the loan amount.

10. The Prosecution has examined CW2/PW2 who is the Retired Manager of Syndicate Bank,
wherein he has deposed that accused No.1 has obtained loan of Rs.23,00,000/- and they have sanctioned the loan after verifying the entire records and legal opinion.
The amount was transferred in the name of accused No.3 who is the owner of the property.
Thereafter, they have found that the accused No.1 has committed fraud and they have not sanctioned further loan to him.

The information is lodged against accused No.1 and detailed investigation was conducted and Final Report was submitted against him.
The loan was sanctioned in the name of the accused No.1 and accused No.2 was surety to the said loan and he was dropped as innocent and arrayed him as a witness to the prosecution.
Accused No.3 was the alleged owner of the property from whom this accused No1 has purchased the property by availing loan from the Bank.

On perusal of the evidence of PW1 who is the Bank manager has deposed that this accused has K Diwakaran vs Harihar Hedge @ Sripada on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169280485/

sentences.text: However, in his cross- examination he has deposed that he has verified the entire documents before sanctioning the loan.
He has obtained the information from the Legal Cell of their Bank.
One persons was deputed from their Bank to visit the property to ascertain it's existence before sanctioning the loan.
CW4 who was the valuer had been to the property as per the request of the Bank and valued the property by personally visiting the site.
This witness has further deposed that accused No.1 has furnished the original registered sale deed and after going through the sale deed, they have sanctioned the loan.
20. The CW2/PW2, the Retired Manager of Syndicate Bank in his cross-examination
has categorically admitted that before sanctioning the loan, they have deputed one retired civil engineer on 27.08.2016 has valued the property by personally visiting the site.

After the Valuation Report,
they have sanctioned a loan of Rs.12,95,000/- in the name of accused No.3 who was the original owner to the property from whom this accused No.1 has purchased his site.
The entire DD was issued in the name of the accused No.3 and not in the name of the accused No.1.
Based on the DD issued in the name of accused No.3, this accused No.3 has executed the said sale deed in favour of accused No.1.
The said sale deed was produced before the Bank before obtaining loan by the accused No.1.
PW3 and PW4 and who were the legal advisor to the bank in their evidence have deposed that they have issued legal opinions to the Bank on verifying the entire records.

Further on perusal of the evidence of CW6/PW5 who is in possession of the alleged property has deposed that he has purchased the property during the year 1995 and he has constructed two shops and one godown during the year 1995 itself in the said disputed plot.
Accused No.1 is no way concerned to his property.
Then the question arises who has played fraud?.
When the Bank has personally visited the plot before sanctioning the loan.
The building was constructed during the year 1995 and this loan was sanctioned in the year 2016 in the name of the accused No.1 and DD was issued in the name of accused No.3.
CW4/PW7 in his evidence has deposed that as per the directions of the Bankers, the informant had been to the site on 27.08.2016 and valued the property during the year 2016.
Which means that the Bank Manager was also had been to the property to see its existence.
The valuer has valued the property to an amount of Rs.16,00,000/-.
CW1/PW1 himself has deposed that the Bank had deputed the valuer of the property CW4 to verify the records and directed him to personally visit the site.
As per the directions of the Bank, CW4 a civil engineer had been to the site and valued then property.
Based on his valuation and also the legal opinion, the Banker has sanctioned the loan in the name of accused No.1.
When such being the case, how the Prosecution is now claiming that accused No.1 has obtained the loan on the site by playing fraud.
Further there is no investigation in respect of the existence of the property.

21. The IO in his evidence has deposed that he never been to the site to ascertain in whose name the said property is standing nor he has collected the documents to show who is the owner to the property.
How the Bank sanctioning the loan without ascertaining whether the said property is converted in to NA or it is still an agricultural land.
The Informant in his evidence has deposed that the accused No.1 has paid installment.
When the accused No.1 has paid installment how can be say that the accused has played fraud.
It looks the accused was sacrificed.
The Prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt that accused No.1 that he has played fraud and obtained loan of Rs.12,90,000/-.
Absolutely, there are no evidence to show that accused No.1 has played fraud.

Under these circumstances, I am holding that the Prosecution has not proved the guilt of accused K Diwakaran vs Harihar Hedge @ Sripada on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169280485/

sentences.text:
Hence, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
22. POINT No.2 :- For the reasons stated in Point No.1, the prosecution has not proved the guilt of accused No.1 for the offences punishable under Sections 120B and 420 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code beyond all reasonable doubt.
Therefore, accused No.1 is not found guilty for the aforesaid offences charged against him.

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:-
ORDERS
Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C, accused No.1 is hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under Sections 120B and 420 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
His bail bonds and surety bonds executed will be in force till appeal period and thereafter, it shall be canceled.
